name: locomo-mini
description: LOCOMO-style long-conversation memory recall: a haystack of dialogue-derived facts about a few people, then single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, and open-domain questions. Hand-curated + license-clean (not the LOCOMO dataset itself).

memories.content: Maya told the group she adopted a rescue greyhound named Pixel in January.
Maya mentioned she is allergic to shellfish and once ended up in the ER after eating shrimp.
Maya started a new job as a data scientist at Northwind Labs in February.
Maya said Northwind Labs is headquartered in Seattle and she works remotely from Denver.
Dev is training for the Chicago marathon and runs every morning before work.
Dev switched from a vegetarian to a vegan diet in March for ethical reasons.
Dev and Maya went to college together at the University of Michigan.
Priya bought her first house in the Oakland hills in April after years of renting.
Priya plays cello in a community orchestra that performs twice a year.
Priya is Dev's manager on the platform infrastructure team.
The friends are planning a group trip to Lisbon in September to celebrate Maya's new job.
Maya is bringing Pixel to the Lisbon trip because the rental is pet-friendly.

questions.question: What is the name of Maya's dog?
What food is Maya allergic to?
Where is Maya's employer Northwind Labs headquartered?
What marathon is Dev training for?
Which university did Dev and Maya both attend?
Who manages Dev on the infrastructure team?
In which month did Maya start her new job?
When did Dev change to a vegan diet?
Why is the group traveling to Lisbon?
Why can Maya bring her dog on the Lisbon trip?
